# Adaptive shortlist cross-view consensus development v1

Development-only: the rule was selected using the already-consumed ArkType/class-validator and Effect/react-hook-form results. It is not fresh evidence.

- Scorable cases: 24
- Unfiltered top-five accuracy: 19/24 (79.2%)
- Cross-view-supported coverage: 15/24 (62.5%)
- Cross-view-supported top-five accuracy: 14/15 (93.3%)
- Cross-view-supported likely-file accuracy: 11/15 (73.3%)

The selected rule requires one exact declaration to occur in the full-text, title-only, and body-only top-five lists. The label supports only the bounded shortlist. It does not support likely-file or exact-owner confidence.
